name: NovaPoshta API
description: AlternativeCommerce NovaPoshta API — Nova Poshta carrier integration for the Basket online-store module.
project_description: AlternativeCommerce NovaPoshta API adds Nova Poshta (Ukraine's dominant parcel carrier) delivery to a Basket store. It talks to the Nova Poshta REST API v2.0 (api.novaposhta.ua) for city/warehouse reference data, delivery-cost calculation, counterparty/contact-person management, express-waybill (internet-document) creation and shipment tracking. Because Nova Poshta is warehouse-based, checkout offers Region -> City -> Warehouse (branch) selectors, plus optional courier-to-address and settlement/street autocomplete. Reference lists (areas, cities) and the store's waybill list are refreshed on cron or via drush commands, and shipment data is surfaced in admin Views. Requires the Basket store module and core Views; the drupal.org project is packaged as basket_novaposhta but the module machine name is novaposhta.
